targetId.description: Optional polymorphic target id corresponding to targetType (matches underlying target_id column). Nullable when not applicable.

details.description: Free-text or structured payload (stored as text) describing the event. May contain sensitive forensic information; server MUST gate access to unredacted details to authorized admin/forensic callers.

ip.description: Source IP address captured for the event. Nullable if not recorded. Treat as sensitive PII and expose only to authorized admin callers.

href.description: Optional request URL or resource href associated with the event; nullable if not recorded. Expose only to authorized admin callers.

userAgent.description: User agent string captured at time of event; nullable. Expose only to authorized admin callers.

createdAt.description: Event ingestion timestamp (maps to created_at).

updatedAt.description: Record last-updated timestamp for operational corrections (maps to updated_at).

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp for audit records (rare; used for redaction). Nullable when not deleted (maps to deleted_at).

ITodoAppAuditLog.IRequest.description: Search and pagination request for audit log queries (API-facing). Field names use camelCase. Filters map to corresponding Prisma columns in todo_app_audit_logs. Callers must be admin; includeDeleted is admin-only and must be enforced server-side.

q.description: Optional full-text search term applied to the 'details' field. Implementations SHOULD sanitize input for safe trigram/full-text queries.

eventType.description: Optional canonical event type to filter by (e.g., 'export','delete','moderation_action').

userId.description: Optional filter by acting user id (maps to todo_app_todouser_id). Nullable.

adminId.description: Optional filter by acting admin id (maps to todo_app_admin_id). Nullable.

listId.description: Optional filter by list id (maps to todo_app_list_id). Nullable.

taskId.description: Optional filter by task id (maps to todo_app_task_id). Nullable.

createdAfter.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for createdAt (ISO 8601 date-time).

createdBefore.description: Optional exclusive upper bound for createdAt (ISO 8601 date-time).

includeDeleted.description: When true include audit records that have a deletedAt timestamp. Admin-only flag; default false.

oneOf.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: 'createdAt' or 'eventType'.
Field to sort by. Allowed values: 'createdAt' or 'eventType'.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: 'createdAt' or 'eventType'.

oneOf.description: Sort order. Allowed values: 'asc' or 'desc'. Default: 'asc'.
Sort order. Allowed values: 'asc' or 'desc'. Default: 'asc'.

order.description: Sort order. Allowed values: 'asc' or 'desc'. Default: 'asc'.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination. Server may apply max bounds.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Server enforces an upper bound for safety (e.g., 100).

ITodoAppAdminAction.description: Detailed administrative action record mapped to the Prisma model `todo_app_admin_actions`. Contains metadata about moderator activities such as 'suspend_account', 'remove_public_list', and 'apply_legal_hold'. Fields correspond to the database columns; sensitive free-text fields (details) may contain investigation notes and should be redacted per policy when exposing to lower-privilege actors.

id.description: Primary identifier of the admin action (UUID).

admin.description: Summary information for the acting administrator (todo_app_admin). Present because todo_app_admin_actions.todo_app_admin_id is required in the Prisma model. Use .ISummary to avoid circular expansion.

adminSession.description: Optional summary of the admin session that performed the action. Nullable when session context is not available.

affectedUser.description: Optional summary of the affected todo user (if any). Nullable when the action did not target a specific user or user removed.

action.description: Canonical action code describing the administrative operation. The DB stores this as free-form string but the product uses canonical codes (examples): 'suspend_account', 'remove_public_list', 'apply_legal_hold'. Implementers SHOULD use these canonical codes consistently. Example: 'suspend_account'.

reason.description: Optional human-supplied reason or policy code for the action. May be redacted in lower-privilege views.

targetType.description: Optional polymorphic target type (for example: 'list','task','account'). Nullable when not applicable.

targetId.description: Optional polymorphic target id (UUID) when the action targets a specific domain object.

details.description: Optional free-text details or JSON payload (stored as text) describing the event for forensic analysis. May contain sensitive notes; redact when necessary.

auditCaseId.description: Optional internal case identifier linking related moderation records.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the admin action was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time for the admin action record (for annotations). Nullable when not present.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the admin action record (rare; used for legal redaction). Nullable when not soft-deleted.

ITodoAppAdminAction.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching/listing administrative actions. Supports filtering, pagination, and sorting. This DTO is intended for admin dashboard use and must be validated server-side for authorization and input correctness.

limit.description: Page size (number of items per page). Server should enforce an upper bound (recommended max 100).

action.description: Optional filter by admin action code (exact match). Example: 'suspend_account'.

auditCaseId.description: Optional filter to find actions associated with a specific internal case id.

affectedUserId.description: Optional filter to return actions that affected the specified user (UUID).

adminId.description: Optional filter by acting admin id (UUID). Use with care: when the requesting actor is the current admin, their identity is injected from auth and should not be supplied in the body for impersonation protection.

createdAfter.description: Optional filter to return actions created strictly after this timestamp (ISO 8601 / RFC3339).

createdBefore.description: Optional filter to return actions created strictly before this timestamp (ISO 8601 / RFC3339).

oneOf.description: Sort by createdAt.
Sort by action code.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by. Allowed values: 'createdAt' or 'action'. Defaults to 'createdAt'.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending.
Sort order: descending.

order.description: Sort order. Allowed values: 'asc' or 'desc'. Default: 'asc'.

includeDeleted.description: Admin-only flag: when true, include soft-deleted admin action records (deletedAt IS NOT NULL). Server MUST enforce authorization before honoring this flag.

ITodoAppUserActivityLog.description: Detailed activity log entry for admin drilldown. FK references are expressed as summary objects to prevent raw FK exposure and to follow API response conventions. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_user_activity_logs`. Fields `details`, `ip`, `href`, `userAgent`, and `deletedAt` are nullable and MUST be authorization-gated for non-forensic callers.

id.description: Primary identifier of the audit record (UUID).

admin.description: Optional acting administrator summary (replaces raw todo_app_admin_id). Nullable when the action was not performed by an admin or when the admin record was removed.

adminSession.description: Optional admin session summary that triggered the action (replaces raw todo_app_admin_session_id). Nullable when session context is not available.

user.description: Optional acting user summary (replaces raw todo_app_todouser_id). Nullable when event is system-generated or user removed.

userSession.description: Optional user session summary that generated the activity (replaces raw todo_app_todouser_session_id). Nullable when session not available.

list.description: Optional referenced list summary when the event targets a list. Replaces raw todo_app_list_id.

task.description: Optional referenced task summary when the event targets a task. Replaces raw todo_app_task_id.

eventType.description: Canonical event type (e.g., 'export','delete','visibility_change','moderation_action','login','invite_accept'). Use server-defined values.

targetType.description: Polymorphic target type when applicable (e.g., 'list','task','invitation'). Nullable when not applicable.

targetId.description: Polymorphic target id when applicable (UUID). Nullable when not applicable.

details.description: Free-text details or structured JSON payload (stored as text) describing the event for forensic analysis. MAY contain sensitive data; server MUST redact or truncate for lower-privilege admin views.

ip.description: Source IP address for the event. Considered sensitive PII and should be redacted for non-forensic viewers where policy requires.

href.description: Optional request URL or resource href associated with the event (nullable).

userAgent.description: User agent string captured at time of event. Nullable.

createdAt.description: Event ingestion timestamp (ISO 8601).

updatedAt.description: Record last-updated time for operational corrections. Maps to Prisma `updated_at` and is non-nullable in the DB; include for completeness.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the audit record (nullable). When present the record is considered redacted/deleted and access must be restricted.

ITodoAppUserActivityLog.IRequest.description: Search and pagination request schema for admin activity log listing. Supports filtering, date range, inclusion of soft-deleted records (admin-only), pagination and sorting. All date/time inputs MUST be ISO-8601 / RFC3339 strings.

eventType.description: Filter by canonical event type (exact match). Matches ITodoAppUserActivityLog.eventType.

actorId.description: Filter by acting user id (todo_app_todouser.id). Nullable when not provided.

sessionId.description: Filter by acting session id (todo_app_todouser_session.id). Nullable when not provided.

listId.description: Filter by list id (todo_app_lists.id). Nullable when not provided.

taskId.description: Filter by task id (todo_app_tasks.id). Nullable when not provided.

includeSoftDeleted.description: Admin-only flag. When true, include soft-deleted records (deletedAt IS NOT NULL). Callers without admin scope MUST be denied (403) if they set this flag to true.

page.description: Page number, 1-based. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

pageSize.description: Page size. Max allowed by server policy is 100.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed: 'createdAt' or 'eventType'. Defaults to 'createdAt'.

ITodoAppTaskSnapshot.description: Detailed append-only snapshot record capturing a point-in-time state of a task. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_task_snapshots`. Contains task fields (title, description, isCompleted, completedAt, dueDate), attribution (user, userSession) and monotonic version and snapshotCreatedAt timestamp. Attribution fields are returned only to authorized callers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the snapshot (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.id).

todo.description: Parent todo (task) summary providing context for this snapshot. Replaces the raw foreign key todo_app_task_id and avoids circular expansion. Returned as a summary object to authorized callers.

user.description: Optional acting user (summary) who caused the snapshot. Nullable and withheld from callers without authorization. Replaces raw todo_app_todouser_id.

userSession.description: Optional acting session summary that triggered the snapshot. Nullable and returned only to authorized callers. Replaces raw todo_app_todouser_session_id.

title.description: Task title captured at snapshot time.

description.description: Task description captured at snapshot time. Nullable when no description was present.

isCompleted.description: Completion flag captured at snapshot time. (Maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.is_completed)

completedAt.description: Completion timestamp captured in the snapshot, if any. Nullable.

dueDate.description: Due date captured in the snapshot, if any. Nullable.

originalCreatedAt.description: Original task created_at value for historical reference (copied into the snapshot when taken). Nullable.

snapshotCreatedAt.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was taken (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.snapshot_created_at).

version.description: Monotonic snapshot version number for the task (unique per task).

ITodoAppTaskSnapshot.IRequest.description: Request DTO for listing or searching task snapshots. Supports pagination, cursor/pageOffset, version range, date range, actor filtering, full-text query and sorting. NOTE: actorId and attribution filters are authorization-gated and results may redact attribution fields for unauthorized callers.

page.description: 1-based page number. Use either page/pageSize or pageToken for pagination. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Server enforces a maximum cap (default 100).

pageOffset.description: Zero-based offset for offset-based pagination as an alternative to page/pageSize.

pageToken.description: Opaque page token for cursor-based pagination. Mutually exclusive with page/pageOffset in client usage patterns.

snapshotFrom.description: Include snapshots whose snapshotCreatedAt is >= this timestamp.

snapshotTo.description: Include snapshots whose snapshotCreatedAt is <= this timestamp.

actorId.description: Optional filter by acting user id (todo_app_todouser.id). This filter is authorization-gated: only owners/admins may filter by actor and receive attribution in results.

isCompleted.description: Optional filter to include only snapshots where the captured isCompleted flag matches this value.

q.description: Full-text search query applied to title and description (simple text search).

oneOf.description: Field to sort by.
Field to sort by.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by. Allowed values: 'version' or 'snapshotCreatedAt'.

oneOf.description: Sort direction.
Sort direction.

ITodoAppTaskSnapshot.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a Task Snapshot (todo_app_task_snapshots). Compact, read-optimized view of a historical snapshot of a task used for audit and history views. This projection maps back to the underlying Prisma model `todo_app_task_snapshots` and intentionally replaces raw foreign keys with safe summary objects. Authorization notes: `user` and `userSession` attribution fields are sensitive and SHOULD be redacted for callers that are not the task owner or authorized admins. `todo` corresponds to the original todo_app_task_id foreign key of the snapshot.

id.description: Unique identifier of the snapshot (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.id).

version.description: Monotonic snapshot version number for the task (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.version).

snapshotCreatedAt.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was taken (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.snapshot_created_at).

title.description: Task title captured at the time of the snapshot (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.title).

description.description: Optional task description captured at snapshot time (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.description). Nullable when the original task had no description.

isCompleted.description: Completion flag captured in the snapshot (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.is_completed).

completedAt.description: Completion timestamp captured in the snapshot, if any (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.completed_at). Nullable.

dueDate.description: Due date captured in the snapshot, if any (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.due_date). Nullable.

originalCreatedAt.description: Original task creation timestamp preserved in the snapshot (maps to todo_app_task_snapshots.original_created_at). Nullable.

todo.description: Reference to the task this snapshot belongs to (replaces raw todo_app_task_id). Use this field to navigate to the current task summary; it provides id/title/context without exposing raw FK semantics.

user.description: Optional actor (todo_app_todouser) who caused the snapshot. Nullable when the snapshot was system-generated or actor is unavailable. Access to this attribution MUST be authorization-gated and redacted for unauthorized callers.

userSession.description: Optional session summary that attributed the change to a particular session (maps to todo_app_todouser_session_id). Nullable when session attribution is not available. Access MUST be gated to authorized callers.

ITodoAppAdminDashboard.description: Administrative dashboard aggregation DTO computed across multiple Prisma models (todo_app_todouser, todo_app_lists, todo_app_tasks, todo_app_invitations, todo_app_audit_logs, todo_app_user_activity_logs). Intended for admin/operator UIs. This response is read-only, may be cached, and MUST NOT include sensitive fields. Arrays are capped by default (top 10 shown) for UI performance; servers MUST provide paginated drill-down endpoints to retrieve full lists.

totals.description: High-level aggregated totals for users, lists and invitations.

taskStats.description: Aggregated task-level statistics such as total tasks and completion rate.

recentAdminActions.description: Capped list (default top 10) of recent admin actions. Entries are redacted of PII for non-forensic callers. Use the admin actions search endpoint for paginated full history.

topLists.description: Top lists by recent activity or other ranking. Capped by default for dashboard display; full results available from paginated list endpoints.

recentInvitations.description: Recently created or soon-expiring invitations. Invitee email or invite_code fields in these summaries are sensitive and MUST be redacted for callers that are not the list owner or invitee.

users.description: Optional small sample of user summaries (capped). Contains only non-sensitive fields; do not use this array as the authoritative user listing — use paginated user endpoints.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) when this dashboard snapshot was generated.

ITodoAppUserDashboard.description: Per-user dashboard summary for the authenticated todoUser. Computed, read-only DTO scoped to the authenticated principal. Arrays are included in responses and when empty MUST be returned as empty arrays. Arrays are capped by default (top 20) for interactive performance; pagination endpoints exist for full retrieval. upcomingDueTasks and recentCompletedTasks use ITodoAppTask.ISummary which includes completedAt and required list context.

user.description: Summary of the authenticated user (non-sensitive). Uses the canonical TodoUser summary type.

counts.description: Key numeric counts for quick display (lists, tasks, due soon, recent completions).

ownedLists.description: Capped array (default top 20) of lists owned by the user. When no owned lists exist return an empty array []. Use paginated endpoints to retrieve full list sets.

sharedLists.description: Capped array of lists the user participates in as collaborator (default top 20). When none, return [].

upcomingDueTasks.description: Tasks due within the user's upcoming window (default next 7 days). Array is capped (default top 20) for dashboard performance. Each item includes parent list context (list) and completedAt when applicable.

recentCompletedTasks.description: Recently completed tasks (capped). Each item includes completedAt and parent list summary for navigation context. When none, return [].

pendingInvitations.description: Pending invitations for the user (capped). Only invitations visible to the authenticated user are returned. When none, return [].

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when this dashboard snapshot was generated (ISO 8601).

IUserDashboardCounts.description: Simple numeric counts used on the user's dashboard. These are computed values for the authenticated user's dashboard. Counts exclude soft-deleted rows (records where deleted_at IS NOT NULL) and reflect current persisted data at the time of computation. Field names use camelCase to align with API conventions.

totalLists.description: Total number of lists owned by the user. Excludes soft-deleted lists (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). Example: 5

sharedListsCount.description: Number of lists where the user is an accepted collaborator (exclude pending invites and soft-deleted lists). Example: 2

totalTasks.description: Total number of tasks across the user's owned lists. Excludes soft-deleted tasks. Example: 42

dueSoonCount.description: Number of tasks that are due within the configured 'due soon' window (typically next 7 days). Excludes completed and soft-deleted tasks. Example: 3

recentCompletedCount.description: Number of tasks completed within the recent reporting window (e.g., last 7 days). Excludes soft-deleted tasks. Example: 10

ITodoAppGlobalSearch.IRequest.description: Request DTO for the global search endpoint. Accepts a free-text query, pagination (offset or cursor), optional entity filters and scoping filters. By convention this search excludes soft-deleted entities (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) and enforces visibility rules: private lists/tasks are returned only to authorized callers (owner or accepted collaborator). Pagination supports either offset-style (page/pageSize) or cursor-style (cursor) — clients SHOULD NOT send both; servers MAY prefer cursor when provided or return 400 for mixed usage.

query.description: Full-text search query string. May be null when callers rely on structured filters instead. When provided, servers SHOULD apply relevance scoring and may use text-indexes for matching. Example: "groceries"

page.description: 1-based page number for offset pagination. Default: 1. When using cursor-based pagination (cursor), this parameter is ignored.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page for offset pagination. Default: 25. Servers SHOULD clamp to a safe maximum to prevent abuse.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for stable cursor-based pagination. When present, server MAY ignore page/pageSize in favor of cursor semantics. Clients SHOULD treat this as mutually exclusive with page/pageSize.

entityFilters.description: Optional list of entity types to restrict the search to. When omitted, the search covers all supported entity types. Allowed values: 'task','list','user','tag'.

ownerId.description: Optional owner UUID to scope results to resources owned by a specific todo user. Must be a valid RFC-4122 UUID when present. Servers validate format and permissions; unauthorized scopes should return 403.

listId.description: Optional list UUID to limit task hits to a particular list. Must be a valid RFC-4122 UUID when present. Servers validate visibility and existence.

oneOf.description: 'relevance' is meaningful when a text query is provided. Default: 'relevance' if query present, otherwise 'createdAt'.
Field used to sort returned hits. Default when no query provided: 'createdAt'.
Field used to sort returned hits by last modification time.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort returned hits.

oneOf.description: Sort direction for the results. Default: 'asc'.
Sort direction for the results. Default: 'asc'.

order.description: Sort direction for the results. Default: 'asc'.

includeSnippets.description: When true, the server SHOULD include short matched text snippets for each hit when supported by the backend index. Default: false.

highlight.description: When true, the server MAY include highlight metadata for match locations (if supported). Default: false.

restrictToAccessible.description: When true, restrict results strictly to resources the caller is authorized to view (owner or accepted collaborator for private resources). Servers MUST enforce visibility regardless of this flag; this flag requests stricter enforcement in multi-tenant scenarios. Default: true.

ITodoAppCollaborationPermission.IRequest.description: Admin-only request DTO to search, filter and page collaboration permission definitions (todo_app_collaboration_permissions). Intended for administrative UIs and automation. Uses camelCase property names consistent with other IRequest DTOs.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Recommended default: 25. Server will enforce a maximum of 200.

code.description: Optional partial or full permission code to filter on (e.g., 'list.read'). Implementations MAY apply case-insensitive partial matching. Server should trim and normalize input before applying uniqueness or equality checks.

isGrantable.description: Optional boolean filter. When provided, only permission records matching the grantable flag are returned.

description.description: Optional free-text search applied to the permission description field. Server may apply full-text matching or simple substring matching and MUST enforce reasonable query limits.

oneOf.description: Sort field for results. Default: 'createdAt'.
Sort field for results. Default: 'createdAt'.
Sort field for results. Default: 'createdAt'.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: 'createdAt','code','updatedAt'. Default: 'createdAt'.

oneOf.description: Sort order. Default: 'asc'.
Sort order. Default: 'asc'.

ITodoAppCollaborationPermission.description:
Collaboration permission definition mapping to the Prisma model `todo_app_collaboration_permissions`.

This schema represents a single permission record used by the collaboration subsystem. It exposes the canonical permission `code`, an optional human `description`, a boolean `isGrantable` indicating whether the permission can be assigned to collaborators, and standard timestamps. Fields correspond exactly to the Prisma model columns and include x-autobe-prisma-schema for linkage.

id.description: Primary key (UUID) of the permission record. Maps to todo_app_collaboration_permissions.id.

code.description: Canonical permission code (unique) used by the application (e.g. 'list.read', 'list.write'). This value is defined by administrators and is used for authorization checks.

description.description: Optional human-friendly description for admin UIs and operator reference. Nullable when not provided.

isGrantable.description: Indicates whether this permission may be granted to collaborators. Mirrors todo_app_collaboration_permissions.is_grantable.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp in RFC3339 / ISO 8601 format. Maps to created_at in the Prisma model.

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp in RFC3339 / ISO 8601 format. Maps to updated_at in the Prisma model.

ITodoAppCollaborationPermission.ICreate.description: Create DTO for a collaboration permission definition. Admin-only endpoint: creates a new permission code that the collaboration subsystem may later present and validate. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_collaboration_permissions`. Business rule: `code` must be unique across permission records; attempts to create a duplicate code should result in a 409 Conflict from the API layer.

code.description: Canonical permission code (unique). Example values: 'list.read', 'list.write'. Must be a non-empty string and unique across the permission dictionary.

description.description: Optional human-friendly description for admin UIs. Nullable when not provided.

isGrantable.description: Whether this permission may be assigned to collaborators (true = grantable to collaborators; false = reserved for internal/system use).

ITodoAppCollaborationPermission.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for a collaboration permission definition. Admin-only operation. All fields are optional; include only fields to change. When updating `code`, the server MUST enforce uniqueness and return 409 Conflict on collisions. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_collaboration_permissions`.

code.description: Updated canonical permission code. If provided, it must be non-empty and must not collide with another permission's code; collisions should return 409 Conflict.

description.description: Optional human-friendly description. Provide null to clear an existing description.

isGrantable.description: Whether this permission may be assigned to collaborators (true = grantable).

id.description: Unique identifier of the collaborator record (todo_app_list_collaborators.id).

oneOf.description: Read-only collaborator: may view list contents but cannot create, modify, or delete tasks.
Read-write collaborator: may create, update, complete/uncomplete, and delete tasks within the list as granted by the owner.

role.description: Assigned collaborator role for this membership. Allowed exact values: 'read-only' or 'read-write'. This maps directly to the Prisma `role` column and MUST use these exact tokens.

user.description: Collaborator user summary (non-null). Replaces raw todo_app_todouser_id. This property is non-null because the underlying Prisma FK is non-nullable.

addedBy.description: Summary of the user who added the collaborator (non-null). Replaces raw added_by_todouser_id.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when the collaborator accepted the invitation, or null if not accepted. Maps to todo_app_list_collaborators.accepted_at (nullable).

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (todo_app_list_collaborators.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp (todo_app_list_collaborators.updated_at).

ITodoAppListCollaborator.ISummary.description: Summary view of a list collaborator. Designed for inclusion in list and user-facing responses. Fields reflect Prisma nullability: user and addedBy are non-nullable in the DB and therefore non-null here. `acceptedAt` remains nullable. `deletedAt` is intentionally omitted from this public summary; admin/forensic endpoints may expose it when authorized.

id.description: Unique identifier of the invitation record (todo_app_invitations.id).

oneOf.description: Invitation has been issued and awaits acceptance by the invitee.
Invitee accepted the invitation. Server sets acceptedAt when transitioning to this state.
Invitee declined the invitation.
Invitation expired (business default: expired after 14 days). Typically set by background expiry processing.
Owner or admin revoked the pending invitation before acceptance.

state.description: Invitation lifecycle state. Allowed exact values: 'pending','accepted','declined','expired','revoked'. Servers MUST validate transitions and enforce authorization for state changes.

inviteCode.description: Opaque invite token (todo_app_invitations.invite_code). SENSITIVE: included only when the caller is the list owner or the invitee. For other authorized viewers (collaborators or admins without explicit need), the field MUST be returned as null or omitted by the API layer. Do NOT log or leak this token in unsecured channels.

inviteeEmail.description: Email address the invitation was sent to when the invitee is not a registered user. Nullable when invitee_todouser_id was used instead. For privacy, servers SHOULD redact or omit this field for callers who are not the owner or the invitee.

invitee.description: If the invitee is a registered user, a summary object for that user; null otherwise. Maps to invitee_todouser_id (nullable).

inviter.description: Summary of the user who sent the invitation (inviter). Non-nullable to reflect Prisma inviter_todouser_id.

list.description: Summary of the target list for context. Non-nullable since todo_app_list_id is non-nullable in Prisma.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp enforcing the business 14-day rule; nullable if no expiry is set.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when the invitation was accepted; null if not accepted. Server-managed (do not set client-side).

createdAt.description: Invitation creation timestamp (todo_app_invitations.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp (todo_app_invitations.updated_at). Nullable when not present.

ITodoAppInvitation.ISummary.description: Summary representation of an invitation to collaborate on a list. Includes contextual references (inviter and list) as Summary objects. `inviter` and `list` are non-nullable to reflect DB constraints. `inviteCode` is SENSITIVE and must be redacted for unauthorized callers; `invitee` and `inviteeEmail` remain nullable to reflect optional invitees.

ITodoAppTask.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a Task (todo_app_tasks). Lightweight representation used when embedding task context in other DTOs. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_tasks`.

Properties include the minimal fields required for list and reference displays. Per response DTO rules the parent belongs-to relation is included as a summary object to provide immediate context for the task without requiring additional API calls.

id.description: Unique identifier of the task (maps to todo_app_tasks.id).

title.description: Short task title as stored in the database (maps to todo_app_tasks.title).

dueDate.description: Optional due date/time for the task (maps to todo_app_tasks.due_date). Nullable when no due date is set. Use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 format.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (maps to todo_app_tasks.created_at). Use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 format.

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp (maps to todo_app_tasks.updated_at). Non-nullable in the Prisma model; present here for summary consistency. Use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 format.

list.description: Parent list as ITodoAppList.ISummary. Replaces raw todo_app_list_id to provide context (id, title, visibility, owner summary) without exposing raw foreign keys.

ITodoAppGuest.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a guest record. Includes stable identifier and lightweight display label. Derived from the Prisma model `todo_app_guest` (see model comments).

id.description: Primary identifier of the guest (maps to todo_app_guest.id in the Prisma schema).

anonymousLabel.description: Optional transient label for display purposes (nullable). Maps to todo_app_guest.anonymous_label.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (maps to todo_app_guest.created_at). Use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 format.

updatedAt.description: Record last update timestamp (maps to todo_app_guest.updated_at). Non-nullable in the Prisma model; included and required here to match DB nullability. Use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 format.

id.description: Primary identifier for the audit event (maps to todo_app_audit_logs.id).

targetType.description: Polymorphic target type when applicable (e.g., 'list','task','invitation'). Nullable when event has no specific typed target.

targetId.description: Polymorphic target identifier (UUID) when applicable. Nullable when not applicable.

user.description: Optional acting user (owner or collaborator) who performed the event. Represented as a non-sensitive summary object. Nullable to preserve audit when user removed.

admin.description: Optional acting administrator who performed the event. Represented as a non-sensitive summary object. Nullable to preserve audit when admin removed.

list.description: Optional parent list context (summary) when the audit event relates to a list. Nullable when not applicable.

task.description: Optional task context (summary) when the audit event relates to a task. Nullable when not applicable.

createdAt.description: Event ingestion time / snapshot timestamp (maps to todo_app_audit_logs.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Record last-updated time for operational corrections (maps to todo_app_audit_logs.updated_at). Nullable when not present.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the audit record (rare; used for legal redaction). Nullable when not deleted.

ITodoAppAuditLog.ISummary.description: Lightweight summary of an audit log entry. Contains identifying metadata (eventType, optional target information and actor summaries) but omits verbose payloads ('details') to keep the summary compact. Mapped to the Prisma model `todo_app_audit_logs`. All property names use camelCase to align with API DTO conventions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the admin action (Prisma PK).

reason.description: Optional human-supplied reason or policy code provided by the administrator when performing the action. Nullable when no reason was provided.

targetType.description: Optional polymorphic target type that the action applies to (for example: 'list','task','account'). Nullable when not applicable.

targetId.description: Optional identifier of the targeted resource when available (UUID). Nullable when not applicable.

admin.description: Lightweight summary of the administrator who performed the action. Belongs-to relation represented as a .ISummary to avoid circular expansion.

affectedUser.description: Optional summary of the affected user account when the action targets a user. Nullable for actions that do not target a user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the admin action was recorded (maps to todo_app_admin_actions.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Last modification time for the record (maps to todo_app_admin_actions.updated_at). Nullable when not present.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp for redaction or legal expiry. Nullable when not present.

ITodoAppAdminAction.ISummary.description: Summary view of an administrative action. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_admin_actions`. This summary is intended for list and audit displays and therefore includes identifying fields, action metadata, and lightweight references to the acting admin and affected user. Field names are camelCase for API consistency.

ITodoAppUserActivityLog.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a user activity log entry. Maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_user_activity_logs`. Intended for activity feeds and admin/audit lists. Note: several fields (details, ip, href, userSession) may contain sensitive information and MUST be redacted or omitted for non-forensic callers — only authorized admin/forensic actors should receive unredacted values.

id.description: Primary identifier of the activity log entry (maps to todo_app_user_activity_logs.id).

activityType.description: Canonical activity code (e.g. 'login','logout','invite_accept','import_request','export_request'). Use the server-defined canonical values for consistent authorization and UX.

details.description: Optional free-text or structured payload (stored as text in DB) describing the activity. MAY contain sensitive forensic information (for example, error traces or export payload references). Servers MUST redact or truncate this field for non-forensic or lower-privilege callers; full details are available only to authorized admin/forensic consumers.

ip.description: Optional source IP address associated with the activity. Considered sensitive PII in some jurisdictions and MUST be redacted for lower-privilege callers unless a forensic/admin context is authorized.

href.description: Optional request URL or resource href associated with the activity. Nullable when not recorded. This may include internal app URLs used for auditing and should be redacted for public callers.

user.description: Summary of the acting user when applicable; null for anonymous or guest-originated events. Returned as ITodoAppTodoUser.ISummary to provide non-sensitive user context.

userSession.description: Optional session summary that triggered the activity (when available). This field can contain sensitive session context and SHOULD be returned only to authorized admin/forensic callers.

list.description: Optional summary of the list context for the activity when applicable. Nullable when the activity is not list-scoped or when the list has been purged.

task.description: Optional summary of the task context for the activity when applicable. Nullable when the activity is not task-scoped or when the task has been purged.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the activity was recorded (ISO 8601 / RFC3339). Maps to todo_app_user_activity_logs.created_at in the Prisma model.

updatedAt.description: Record last-updated timestamp (ISO 8601). Nullable when not present. Maps to todo_app_user_activity_logs.updated_at.

ITodoAppTaskCompletionByDay.ISummary.description: Aggregate summary of task completions grouped by calendar day. This is a computed/reporting DTO (not a direct Prisma model). `date` is a calendar date in the ISO 8601 'YYYY-MM-DD' form representing the aggregation day; servers should document whether the date is normalized to UTC or the user's calendar zone. For large aggregates `completedTaskIds` may be omitted to avoid excessive payload sizes.

date.description: Calendar date for the aggregation day in YYYY-MM-DD format. Pattern enforces zero-padded year-month-day. Server SHOULD document whether this represents UTC calendar day or user-local day; clients should assume UTC unless otherwise specified by API docs.

completedCount.description: Number of tasks that transitioned to completed on the given date. Count excludes soft-deleted tasks and represents final state transitions that occurred within the aggregation window.

completedTaskIds.description: Optional list of task UUIDs completed on that date. Present only when the consumer requests detailed ids; servers may omit this field for large aggregates or when privacy/performance constraints apply.

id.description: Unique identifier for this search result record. When the result represents an entity persisted in the database (for example a list or a task), this is the UUID of that entity.

oneOf.description: Denotes the kind of entity the search result refers to. Use this discriminator to interpret the other fields and route clients to the correct detail endpoint.
Denotes the kind of entity the search result refers to. Use this discriminator to interpret the other fields and route clients to the correct detail endpoint.
Denotes the kind of entity the search result refers to. Use this discriminator to interpret the other fields and route clients to the correct detail endpoint.
Denotes the result is a tag entity. Added to align with global search filters that include tags.

targetType.description: Denotes the kind of entity the search result refers to. Use this discriminator to interpret the other fields and route clients to the correct detail endpoint.

targetId.description: The UUID of the referenced domain entity (todo_app_lists.id, todo_app_tasks.id, todo_app_todouser.id, or todo_app_task_tags.id). Clients should use targetType + targetId to construct navigation links or subsequent API requests.

title.description: Primary human-facing title for the search hit. For lists this is the list.title; for tasks this is the task.title; for users this is the user's display name or email; for tags this is the tag name.

snippet.description: Short highlighted excerpt (plain text) demonstrating why this item matched the query. This field is intended for UI preview and may contain trimmed content.

href.description: Application-level href where the client may navigate to view the referenced entity resource. This is a presentation helper and not a required server-side canonical identifier.

score.description: Full-text relevance score (domain-specific). Higher values indicate better match. This is an opaque numeric value produced by the search service and intended for ordering.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing when the underlying entity (list/task/user/tag) was created (ISO 8601 / RFC3339). Provided to help clients present chronological context in search results.

updatedAt.description: Optional timestamp of last modification for the underlying entity (ISO 8601 / RFC3339). Useful for sorting or rendering freshness indicators.

ITodoAppSearchResult.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a single search result returned by the platform search endpoints.

This type is deliberately a projection (read-only view) and is not a direct one-to-one mapping to any single Prisma model. It contains minimal, UI-friendly fields used by list and search APIs. Fields:

- id: UUID of the referenced entity.
- targetType/targetId: Discriminator pair telling the client which domain entity the result represents ("list", "task", "user", "tag").
- title/snippet: Display fields for preview.
- href: Application navigation URL (presentation helper).
- score: Numeric relevance produced by the search service.

Clients MUST treat this object as a summary view and call the appropriate detail endpoint (for example GET /lists/{id} or GET /tasks/{id}) when full entity data is needed.

id.description: Unique identifier of the permission record in the collaboration permissions dictionary (maps to todo_app_collaboration_permissions.id).

code.description: Machine-friendly permission code used by the API and authorization checks (for example 'list.read' or 'list.write').

description.description: Human-friendly explanation of what the permission grants. Nullable when the database row has no description.

isGrantable.description: Indicates whether this permission may be granted to collaborators. Permissions with false are internal-only and should not be offered in collaborator assignment UIs.

createdAt.description: Record creation time in RFC3339 / ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: Last modification time for the permission record in RFC3339 / ISO 8601 format.

ITodoAppCollaborationPermission.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary view of a collaboration permission. This schema maps to the Prisma model `todo_app_collaboration_permissions` and is used by list/collaboration endpoints to render available grantable permissions. It intentionally omits any internal fields not required by client UIs.

x-autobe-prisma-schema: todo_app_collaboration_permissions

refresh_token.description: Refresh token previously issued to the guest. The server validates this token and, if valid, issues a new short-lived access token. Clients MUST treat this value as sensitive. This property name is aligned with other refresh request DTOs (e.g., ITodoAppAdmin.IRefresh, ITodoAppTodoUser.IRefresh).

ITodoAppGuest.IRefresh.description: Request body for renewing guest authorization. Contains the guest refresh credential. The todo_app_guest model does not persist refresh tokens; token validation is performed by the authentication/session subsystem. Use `refresh_token` (snake_case) to align with other IRefresh request DTOs.

ITodoAppAdminTotals.description: High-level aggregated counts surfaced to admins. All counts exclude soft-deleted records (rows where deleted_at IS NOT NULL) and are non-negative integers representing current persisted state at the time of computation.

total_users.description: Total number of registered users in the system. Excludes soft-deleted user accounts (deleted_at IS NOT NULL).

active_users.description: Number of unique users active within the reporting window. Calculated from activity logs and excludes soft-deleted accounts.

suspended_accounts.description: Number of accounts currently suspended (administrative suspension state). Excludes accounts already purged or hard-deleted.

total_lists.description: Total number of todo lists in the system. Excludes soft-deleted lists (deleted_at IS NOT NULL).

public_lists.description: Count of lists with visibility set to 'public'. Excludes soft-deleted lists.

private_lists.description: Count of lists with visibility set to 'private' or 'shared-invite-only'. Excludes soft-deleted lists.

pending_invitations.description: Number of invitations currently in 'pending' state (awaiting acceptance, not expired). Excludes soft-deleted invitation rows.

ITodoAppTaskStats.description: Summary statistics about tasks across the platform. Counts exclude soft-deleted tasks (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). completionRate is a fractional value in the closed interval [0,1] representing (completed_tasks / total_tasks). When total_tasks is 0, completionRate MUST be 0.

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks present across the system (exclude soft-deleted tasks).

completed_tasks.description: Number of tasks currently marked as completed (exclude soft-deleted tasks).

completion_rate.description: Fractional completion rate computed as completed_tasks / total_tasks. Value is in [0,1]. When total_tasks == 0 the value MUST be 0 to avoid NaN or null.

due_soon_count.description: Number of tasks with due_date within the configured 'due soon' window (e.g., next 7 days). Excludes completed and soft-deleted tasks.

ITodoAppAdminActionSummary.description: Redacted summary of an admin action suitable for dashboard listing. PII removed or truncated. Maps to Prisma model todo_app_admin_actions.

id.description: Audit record identifier (todo_app_admin_actions.id).

action.description: Canonical administrative action code mapping to todo_app_admin_actions.action (e.g., 'suspend_account','remove_public_list','apply_legal_hold'). Use exact server-side codes.

admin.description: Optional acting administrator summary (replaces raw todo_app_admin_id). Nullable when the admin account is not available. Returned where authorized for audit and dashboard contexts.

affectedUser.description: Optional affected user summary when the admin action targeted a user (replaces raw todo_app_todouser_id). Nullable when not applicable.

targetType.description: Polymorphic target type (e.g., 'list','task','account'). Nullable when not applicable.

targetId.description: Identifier of the target resource when available (UUID). Maps to todo_app_admin_actions.target_id.

reason.description: Admin-supplied reason or policy code for the action. Maps to todo_app_admin_actions.reason. Nullable in summary views.

auditCaseId.description: Optional internal case identifier linking related moderation records (todo_app_admin_actions.audit_case_id). Nullable.

detailsSnippet.description: Short redacted snippet describing the admin action for dashboards (no PII). Use for UI summaries; full details remain in audit logs and are authorization-gated.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp for the admin action (maps to todo_app_admin_actions.created_at). Use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp (maps to todo_app_admin_actions.updated_at). Nullable when not present.

ITodoAppListSummary.description: Summary representation of a todo list. Maps to Prisma model todo_app_lists as a read DTO. Designed for compact list views and embeds owner summary for context.

id.description: Unique identifier of the list (todo_app_lists.id).

description.description: Optional list description or notes. Maps to todo_app_lists.description. Nullable when not provided.

owner.description: Owner summary object (transformed from todo_app_todouser_id) providing non-sensitive owner context.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (maps to todo_app_lists.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Record last modification timestamp (maps to todo_app_lists.updated_at).

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Nullable when the list is active. Maps to todo_app_lists.deleted_at. Inclusion in responses should be authorization-gated.

ITodoAppInvitationSummary.description: Summary representation of an invitation to collaborate on a list. Includes contextual references (inviter and list) as Summary objects. `inviter` and `list` are non-nullable to reflect DB constraints. `inviteCode` is SENSITIVE and must be redacted for unauthorized callers; `invitee` and `inviteeEmail` remain nullable to reflect optional invitees.

id.description: Invitation identifier (todo_app_invitations.id).

list.description: Summary of the list the invitation targets.

inviter.description: Summary of the user who issued the invitation. Maps to inviter_todouser_id (non-nullable).

inviteCode.description: Opaque invite token (todo_app_invitations.invite_code). SENSITIVE: included only when the caller is the list owner or the invitee; for other authorized viewers the field MUST be returned as null or omitted by the API layer. Do NOT log or leak this token in unsecured channels.

invitee.description: If the invite targets a registered user, the invitee summary. Maps to invitee_todouser_id (nullable).

inviteeEmail.description: Email used for invitation when invitee not registered. Nullable per Prisma (todo_app_invitations.invitee_email). For privacy, servers SHOULD omit or redact this field for callers who are not the owner or the invitee.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp for the invitation (maps to todo_app_invitations.expires_at in the Prisma schema).

acceptedAt.description: When the invitation was accepted (nullable). Maps to todo_app_invitations.accepted_at.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp for the invitation (maps to todo_app_invitations.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp for the invitation (maps to todo_app_invitations.updated_at).

ITodoAppUserSummary.description: Safe summary of a user account. Excludes sensitive authentication fields. Maps to Prisma model `todo_app_todouser`. Email exposure is authorization-gated (owner/admin may see it).

id.description: User unique identifier (maps to todo_app_todouser.id).

email.description: Primary email of the user. Included in summaries for context; exposure must be authorization-gated (owner/admin). Maps to todo_app_todouser.email.

displayName.description: Optional display name. Nullable when the user has not set one. Maps to todo_app_todouser.display_name.

status.description: Account lifecycle status (e.g., 'pending_verification','active','suspended'). Maps to todo_app_todouser.status.

isVerified.description: Whether the user has verified their email address (maps to todo_app_todouser.is_verified).

createdAt.description: Account creation timestamp (maps to todo_app_todouser.created_at).

updatedAt.description: Account last modification timestamp (maps to todo_app_todouser.updated_at).

ITodoAppTaskSummary.description: Summary view of a task for lists in dashboards. Mapped to Prisma model 'todo_app_tasks'. Provides lightweight task fields for embedding in dashboards and list previews. All timestamps use ISO 8601 / RFC3339 date-time format. Parent list summary is required to provide navigation context.

id.description: Task identifier.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the task was completed (nullable). Maps to todo_app_tasks.completed_at. Present when isCompleted is true; null otherwise.

dueDate.description: Optional due date for the task (ISO 8601 / RFC3339). Nullable if not set. Maps to todo_app_tasks.due_date.

priority.description: Optional business priority. Allowed values: 'low','medium','high','urgent'. Nullable if not provided. Matches the business enum and underlying Prisma column semantics.

createdAt.description: Task creation timestamp (ISO 8601). Maps to todo_app_tasks.created_at.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp (ISO 8601). Maps to todo_app_tasks.updated_at.

list.description: Parent list summary providing minimal context (id + title + visibility). Included to allow clients to render navigation and visibility context. Must be present in dashboard task summaries.
